text: What happens inside the bank when it takes money from a card?
prefix: What happens inside the bank when it takes money from a card?

text: The simplest way is to send one debit request straight to the processing center.
prefix: The simplest way is to send one debit request straight to the processing center.

text: But if two requests run at the same time, or the page is submitted twice, the card is charged twice.
prefix: But if two requests run at the same time, or the page is submitted twice, the card is charged twice.

text: So before any money moves, the payment switches from open to authorizing in one atomic update, and only one request can win it.
prefix: So before any money moves, the payment switches from open to authorizing in one atomic update, and only one request can win it.

text: Every call to the processing center is written to an operation journal, with its result and reference numbers.

text: The bank sends the debit through its terminal, identified by a merchant ID and a terminal ID.

text: The debit runs as authorization and capture: first the money is held, then it is captured.

text: When the processing center approves, the payment becomes captured, with its retrieval reference number.
